title: Ising model and percolation: from hexagonal lattice to 3-12 lattice
comment: 16 pages, 11 figures. In v2, we remove the discussion for self-avoiding walk, as it already appeared in GL13
abstract: In this survey, we extend the conformal invariance of the Ising model and of the percolation from the hexagonal lattice to the 3-12 lattice.
